dedupe_keys.name: eia r client for u s energy data

description: eia is the rOpenSci package for retrieving U.S. Energy Information Administration data in R. It contains directory searches, time-series and geoset requests, date conversion, metadata summaries and request caching. Inputs select API directories, measures, frequencies and time ranges; outputs are tidy tables or raw responses. Geographic coverage includes U.S. national and subnational series and selected international products, with dates and resolution varying by endpoint. The package is free under MIT, confirmed in its DESCRIPTION file. A limitation is that the external EIA service requires the user's registered API key and agreement to service terms. This review inspected the package without registering or making data requests. The client can prepare energy-demand, generation and emissions inputs for infrastructure simulations. EIA-923 (data-eia-923-power-plant-operations) is a related data resource. Software installation and current API responses were not tested.
